runtime_revision.reason: Resolve mjlab's >=3.8.0.3 metadata constraint using the official release with the identical runtime source tree; preserve every other source lock pin. Native compatibility is not established by tree equality.

conditions.initialization: Preserve original reset and RNG order, including startup mass/COM/friction and reset XY/yaw/joints. Save actual initial state; do not assume a standing start.

negative_control.change: Disable collision type and affinity on the four left/right hand/wrist collision geometries through the original scene configuration before compilation. Preserve their source condim=1 and priority=0; no other geometry is disabled.
negative_control.limitation: Disables these four geoms against every partner, including ground. Arm/torso support remains possible and must be counted as other support. This is not a matched policy-training comparison.
negative_control.pairing: Compare initial qpos/qvel, effective mass/inertia/friction and checkpoint to policy-seed-137 before interpreting the negative; retain mismatches as admission failures.

checks.independent_window: Report every contiguous native-step window with height above the source goal threshold, loaded left and right hand contacts, and no loaded ground/other support; longest window is the carrying diagnostic. A 2 s window is five times the source's 0.4 s predicate, not a hardware criterion.
checks.interpretation: Parity and decoding tolerances qualify observation consistency only. Carrying duration alone does not establish complete physical qualification. Keep missing epoch/force/provenance checks explicit; never replace them by a source success flag.

repeat_plan.order: Two fresh-process parity probes, then three named seeds and the paired no-hand control only after probe qualification.
repeat_plan.stop: Stop dependent runs on source/runtime/provenance admission failure, probe mismatch, capacity overflow, nonfinite records, missing telemetry or exhausted budget. Preserve every attempted output. No automatic training or budget extension.

gpu_budget.scope: Whole selected device, including display/other processes. The existing bounded runner stops only its workload when sampled usage exceeds the threshold or telemetry is unavailable. This is not a hard allocation cap; peaks between samples are unobserved.
